title: Microlocal maximal hypoellipticity from the geometric viewpoint: I
summary: Given some vector fields on a smooth manifold satisfying Hörmander's condition, we define a bi-graded pseudo-differential calculus which contains the classical pseudo-differential calculus and a pseudo-differential calculus adapted to the sub-Riemannian structure induced by the vector fields. Our approach is based on geometric constructions (resolution of singularities) together with methods from operators algebras.
